name: Automotive Friction Material
old_description: Proudly serving Birmingham, AL and surrounding markets with clutches and brakes for a huge variety of applications for over 40 years.
about:
Automotive Friction Material operates from Birmingham, Alabama, where it has served the surrounding region with clutch and brake components for more than 40 years. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The business stocks new and remanufactured clutches for automotive, trucking, tractor, and on- and off-highway applications. Its brake shoe inventory ranges from golf cart units to the largest industrial equipment, with a specialization in medium- to heavy-duty brake shoes. The company also supplies electric brakes, industrial brakes, and tractor brakes, and offers a rebuilding service for parts not carried in stock.

Customers span agricultural, automotive, trucking, industrial, mining, and machining sectors. The company positions itself as a direct source for fleets, equipment operators, and repair shops seeking to reduce lead times and costs by bypassing intermediaries.

Automotive Friction Material emphasizes fast service and the ability to source or rebuild hard-to-find components, promoting a direct-to-customer model that aims to save time and money.
